classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design up to two compact binder candidates against a caller-supplied target PDB using two seed-sharded BindCraft trajectories, evaluate each with lightweight sequence QC, and return a ranked pair.
assumptions: target_pdb must be supplied at runtime via params.target_pdb; no PDB was attached to this request so it remains a required parameter.
No hotspot residues were specified; BindCraft will explore the full target surface — valid but may produce lower binding-site specificity than a hotspot-guided run.
Binder length defaults to 60 aa (BindCraft default); caller may override via params.binder_length.
Target chain defaults to A; override via params.target_chain if the receptor occupies a different chain.
Two trajectory shards (seed=1, seed=2, num_designs=1 each) match the tool's recommended_shard_size of 1 and run concurrently at max_parallel=2.
sequence_analysis is applied per design via foreach over each shard's designs array — lightweight charge, motif, and liability QC with no GPU dependency.
rank_designs aggregates both shards' design objects and per-design sequence metrics; top_k=2 covers the full two-candidate set.
filter_mode=default and num_recycles=1 minimise GPU time while preserving upstream BindCraft quality thresholds.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: local path to the target receptor PDB file — required by bindcraft; the workflow cannot execute without it.
